pages.text: Circuits have both an item variant and stored analysis state. A dirty or damaged circuit, a clean unanalysed board, an analysed board and an analysed stable board are not interchangeable just because they share a number.$p$(l)Processing route$()$pExtraction / Precision — Find dirty or damaged circuits from their configured inputs.$pRestoration — Clean dirty circuits into matching boards.$pReassembly — Repair damaged circuits into matching boards.$pProcessing — Combines the cleaning and repair roles.$pAnalysis — Analyse clean boards; reveals stability and can award items/FE.$pFabrication / Plugs / Multiplication — Use the exact board variants and state required by the operation.$p1. Start with a raw chip and read its actual item name: Dirty or Damaged.$p2. Select the cleaning/repair machine that handles that type.$p3. After processing, move the resulting clean board into the Analysing Chamber.$p4. Read the analysed/stable tooltip before placing the board in a Fabrication recipe or Calculator Plug.$p5. Do not reinsert an already analysed board expecting another analysis reward.$pThe analyser has data-driven rewards. Its board state is saved on the item. The guide shows public instructions and recipe state requirements; it does not alter the board, reroll its data, or grant rewards.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/extraction_chamber)Extraction$()$p$(l:foundations_calculator:machines/precision_chamber)Precision$()
